article.title: Missiles Strike Energiya Defense Battery Plant in Yelets
article.summary: Cruise missiles struck the “Energiya” defense plant in Yelets, Lipetsk region of Russia, on Sunday, Oct. 25, hitting Russia’s leading producer of chemical power sources and batteries. Lipetsk Governor Igor Artamonov confirmed an attack on the municipal industrial zone.

article.title: Drones Hit Omsky Kauchuk Deep in Russia, Belgorod Targeted
article.summary: Long-range strike drones have struck the Omsky Kauchuk chemical enterprise and an Ozon logistics hub in Omsk, Siberia – over 2,500 kilometers from Ukraine – igniting a major industrial fire across the production plant.

article.title: Ukraine: Russian strikes hit Odesa and Zaporizhzhia, injuring four
article.summary: Russian overnight strikes injured four people in Zaporizhzhia and sparked fires in the Odesa region on Monday. Ukrainian emergency services said an industrial site was hit twice more as firefighters battled the flames.

article.summary: A Ukrainian court has handed a 12-year prison term to a Russian grenade launcher operator who detained and sexually assaulted a woman in Kharkiv Oblast in 2022.

article.title: How Russia Is Teaching Children To Fly Military Drones
article.summary: Russia wants a million drone operators by 2030 and schools are adapting fast to fill the quota. By the time students are 16, many will be taught how to fly multiple drones and how to use them in combat. The authorities are using games and competitions to draw millions of young people into the field.
